description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticSearchModuleDataPuller class, which facilitates pulling SugarCRM module data, including handling differential updates and deleted records, with methods for batch processing and generating query filters.

classes.name: ElasticSearchModuleDataPuller
classes.description: A class that pulls data from a SugarCRM module, supporting differential updates and batch processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the data puller with module name, differential flag, and logger.

methods.name: setLastIndexTime
methods.description: Sets the last index time used for differential data pulling.

methods.name: setShowDeleted
methods.description: Sets whether to include deleted records in the pull.

methods.name: setDifferential
methods.description: Sets whether the pull is differential, affecting the query filter.

methods.name: pullNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of records from the module based on current offset and batch size.

methods.name: generateWhere
methods.description: Generates the WHERE clause for differential or full data retrieval.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access protected properties.
